† [נשׁם] vb. pant (NH in nn. נְשִׁימָה, נְשָׁמָה, 𝔗 נִשְׁמָא, נִשְׁמְתָא; late Aramaic Ithpe.; Syriac ܢܫܰܡ breathe, blow; Arabic نَسَمَ gently breathe (of wind), etc.; v. seek a thing with labour and perseverance (Lane 3032); نَسَمَةٌ a soul, Lane ib.);—pant, of the deep and strong breathing of a woman in travail;
Qal Impf. 1 s. אֶשֹּׁם Is 42:14.
